CustomField.description: The record ID of the Nonprofit Cloud Gift Transaction this gift is mirrored to or was made from by the Gift Transaction mirror (Connect). Text, not a lookup, so Connect installs where Nonprofit Cloud does not (ADR-0013, ADR-0058).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The Nonprofit Cloud Gift Transaction this gift is mirrored to, or was made from. Filled in by the Gift Transaction mirror. Paste an existing Gift Transaction's record ID to link to it, or clear it to have a new one made.
CustomField.label: Gift Transaction ID
